notes.title: Demo build update (v0.2.0)
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We have prepared a new demo build update.

Patch Notes - Version 0.2.0

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed an issue where enemies continued to move after being defeated.
- Resolved a blocker that occurred when opening chests.
- Updated the description in the quests window for clarity.
- Fixed a bug where the game would unpause if a manual save was performed.
- Game now properly pauses when the map window is open.
- Addressed input blocker during the block state when the pause window is opened.
- Fixed a blocker caused by pressing pause during death animation.
- Corrected the texture for the coins panel.
- Fixed the destruction of dialog popups.
- Adjusted window ordering for better organization.
- Coins now display in the correct position.
- Fixed enemy animation flow during death.
- Item names now display correctly when selling.
- Implemented a new scene loading flow for improved performance.
- Optimized lighting by compressing lightmaps and disabling lightmap streaming.

Gameplay Changes:
- Adjusted weapon positions in hand for better alignment.
- Changed loot drop positions for easier collection.
- Added splash screens for a more polished experience.
- Implemented loot dropping mechanics for defeated enemies.
- Players can now heal during combat for added strategy.
- Enabled pickup and chest opening actions during combat.
- Chests and doors now auto-rotate for easier interaction.
- Implemented healing prompts for better feedback during gameplay.
- Auto-hiding of close button for gamepad users.

Optimizations and Enhancements:
- Implemented optimized item activation for smoother gameplay.
- Refactored debug information for better clarity.
- Adjusted spacing between lines of active quests on the HUD.
- Optimized saving process for faster performance.
- Improved selector awake method.
- Addressed CPU spikes related to weapon effects.
- Streamlined music resource loading.
- Optimized Guardian update method for improved performance.
- Fixed input player addition for better control.
- Fixed settings saving for consistency.

Happy gaming,
Two Cakes Studio
